name: Larian Jambatan Sultan Nazrin Shah 2026 (LJSN26)
short_description: LJSN26 is a half-marathon held on 25 October 2026 in Bagan Datuk, Perak, Malaysia, offering 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distances.
ai_summary: Larian Jambatan Sultan Nazrin Shah 2026 (LJSN26) is a half-marathon event scheduled for 25 October 2026 in Bagan Datuk, Perak, Malaysia. Organized by Majlis Perbandaran Teluk Intan (MPTI), the race offers three distance categories: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, starting from Tapak Pasar Malam, Bagan Datuk. Registration details have not yet been announced.

core_facts.venue: Tapak Pasar Malam, Bagan Datuk, Perak

research_highlights: Course runs across the Sultan Nazrin Shah Bridge, described in event materials as an internationally-rated bridge crossing for all distance categories (21km/10km/5km)
2026 edition flag-off times: 21km at 3:00am, 10km at 3:30am, and 5km at 7:30am, with cut-off times of 3:45hrs (21km), 2hrs (10km) and 1hr (5km)
Event organised by Majlis Perbandaran Teluk Intan with Generasi Athletics Club as co-organiser and Ashkhu Glow Event Management handling event management (per 2025 edition listing)
Venue is Tapak Pasar Malam, Bagan Datuk, Perak — this is the 3rd edition (2024, 2025, and now 2026) of the race

faqs.question: When is Larian Jambatan Sultan Nazrin Shah 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: Larian Jambatan Sultan Nazrin Shah 2026, also known as LJSN26, is scheduled to take place on 25 October 2026. The event will be held at Tapak Pasar Malam in Bagan Datuk, Perak, Malaysia, as organized by the Majlis Perbandaran Teluk Intan.

faqs.question: What distance options are available at LJSN26?
faqs.answer: LJSN26 offers three distance categories for participants to choose from: a 21.1km half-marathon, a 10km run, and a 5km run. This range allows both serious distance runners and casual participants to take part in the event according to their fitness level.

faqs.question: Who organizes this race?
faqs.answer: The race is organized by Majlis Perbandaran Teluk Intan (MPTI), a municipal council in Perak, Malaysia. MPTI oversees the planning and execution of Larian Jambatan Sultan Nazrin Shah 2026, which is set to take place in Bagan Datuk, Perak.

faqs.question: Is registration open for LJSN26?
faqs.answer: As of now, the registration status for LJSN26 has not yet been announced by the organizer, Majlis Perbandaran Teluk Intan (MPTI). Prospective participants should watch for further updates regarding sign-up details, fees, and deadlines ahead of the 25 October 2026 event date.
